fields.statement: QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: go test ./internal/workflow -run TestAgentStepChecks and ./internal/api -run 'TestRunFindingsAgentStepChecks|TestRunFindingsCheckNames' pass; the built binary's workflow describe ship-change shows conduct declaring roles plan, code, qa; run findings --check plan outside a run is refused naming RHIZA_RUN (exit 2).

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: workflow describe ship-change in a fresh repo lists conduct, gate, signoff, push, wait-ci, merge, main-ci, close-out, ship, deploy-check, with every non-pass route up to merge going to handback:conduct and none after it; workflow check ship-change is valid; go test -run 'TestBuiltinShipChange|TestBuildCheck' pass; run build-check and review-check outside a run are refused cleanly (exit 2).

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: workflow ls lists ship-change-classic (builtin); workflow check ship-change-classic is valid; diff of builtin/ship-change-classic.toml against testdata/ship-change-pre-m36.toml is only the name line, and the golden equals origin/main's ship-change.toml; workflow new --from ship-change-classic writes a file that checks valid; TestBuiltinClassicUnchanged passes.

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: All 30 named scripts pass, in three capped batches; the api tests TestPrePushJournal and TestInboxReadsChangeSetsOnce pass, as do the eight workflow tests. grep -L ship-change-classic on the 33 files prints nothing. Builtin("ship-change") appears only in TestBuiltinShipChange.

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: In a scratch repo: SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA naming a fake head made render exec it with 'render --json' in the repo dir; with a real head build, render and land went through it and landed the change set (accepted to landed); with the head as the running binary, render ran in-process; a missing head with no SHIP_HEAD_BUILD made render and land fail with 'not a built rhiza', with nothing rendered or landed. TestLandRenderHeadBuild passes.

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: run start --dry-run on a leafless accepted change set, with no --workflow and with --workflow ship-change, prints '- Workflow: ship-change' (exit 0). The four named scripts, and daemon-picks and daemon-status, pass. internal/daemon TestResumable|TestPick|TestSkips pass.

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: docs/runs-and-daemon.md no longer says 'build and then review' for ship-change. It, docs/custom-workflows.md and guide workflows name the conductor default's steps and ship-change-classic pinned via [ready]. TestWorkflowsText and internal/doclinks pass.

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: In this repo, workflow describe ship-rhiza and bugfix show every hand-back route as handback:ship-change/conduct. A repo ship-change.toml including ship-change is refused as including itself. TestIncludeHandbackTarget and TestHandbackIncluded pass.

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: go test ./internal/run -run TestPastLanding, ./internal/daemon -run TestResumable and ./internal/api -run TestRunResume pass, and the inbox-landed-resumable script passes with fixtures that visited merge and ship-change/merge.

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: Built binary, leafless accepted change set: run start --dry-run with ship-change and with a repo workflow including ship-change starts (exit 0). With ship-change-classic, a repo workflow including build or ship-change-classic, and a dispatch.toml pinning [ready] feature = ship-change-classic, it is refused with exit 3 and 'has no leaves: <workflow> builds and reviews its leaves'. TestCheckShipLeaves and run-ship-needs-leaves pass.

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: go test ./internal/api -run TestReviewCheck passes (TestReviewCheckDeclaredChecks, TestReviewCheckConductor, TestReviewCheckRefusesStaleRound and TestReviewCheckFindingsFlag). The built binary's run review-check outside a run is refused naming RHIZA_RUN.

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: In this repo, workflow describe ship-change resolves to builtin:ship-change; .rhiza/workflows/ship-change.toml is gone. describe ship-rhiza shows the env GOTMPDIR, SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA and SHIP_HEAD_BUILD, go-cleanup (sh .rhiza/workflows/go-cleanup.sh), the 10 included steps and handback:ship-change/conduct. bugfix shows the same. workflow check ship-rhiza, bugfix and plan-bug are valid, with only the bypass warnings AGENTS.md expects. make self-check in a clean detached worktree at HEAD exits 0. TestShipFixPromptsOneLine passes.

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: In a scratch repo, render with SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA missing and SHIP_HEAD_BUILD set built the head once and wrote <bin>.built-at at HEAD. A second render did not rebuild; after a new commit it rebuilt (builds 1, 1, 2). A failing SHIP_HEAD_BUILD failed with its output and 'nothing was rendered or pushed', with nothing rendered. TestShipHeadBuildOnDemand and ship-land-branch-build pass.

QA at 1b3323a74, scratch build of the branch: The ship-change-one-ci script passes, as does ship-check-settles-conflict. ship rebase --no-push against a bare origin merged origin/main into the branch, printed 'Pushed nothing (--no-push)' and left origin's branch at the same SHA. On a code conflict it left the merge in progress (UU, exit 1) with origin unchanged, and on an up-to-date branch it said nothing to merge (exit 0).
